column1: # Batch 40 jpnat3 - candidates fetched 2026-10-02 and NOT written to the manifest, with why. id<TAB>url<TAB>reason

column3: National designated cultural properties DB: search and CSV export are a POST form carrying a per-session _csrfToken (/bsys/searchlist); no static file or GET endpoint

JMA seismic-intensity DB JSON API answers but caps every search at 1,000 events (str: 上限を超えました, newest 1000 shown) with no paging parameter; 2025 alone exceeds it, maxInt=4 since 1919 exceeds it, and an end date past the DB's last day (2026-09-30) is refused, so a fixed window either truncates silently or goes stale - the engine has no rolling-date token
NCC cancer registry/mortality downloads are legacy OLE2 .xls (cancer_mortality(1958-2024).xls etc.); the only .xlsx files are a 64 KB survival table and a 140 KB projection
Notified telecom carrier lists are OLE2 .xls; the CSV form (gt010401.csv) is already registered
MLIT registers of surveying firms (24.9 MB), construction consultants (14.5 MB) and geological survey firms (3.1 MB) are OLE2 .xls (magic d0cf11e0) - unreadable by lib/xlsx.c
National Institutes for Cultural Heritage ColBase API answers 403 {x-api-key error}; the key lives in the site's JS bundle and is not ours to use
JST researchmap API answers 401 invalid_token (access token required)
NIMS Materials Data Repository catalog JSON answers HTTP 410 Gone
www.meti.go.jp still answers HTTP 403 to the honest UA (as in batch 32); End User List unreachable

Consumer accident data bank is an Angular SPA over POST JSON endpoints; paging (startPos/resultSize) lives in the JSON body, which the engine cannot advance (page_param only rewrites the URL); a plain POST {} returns only facet counts
Medical Information Net (navii) open data on the e-Gov portal is ZIP-only; probe_hp_batch.py cannot verify a ZIP body
Procurement portal award open data (yearly all-records and daily diffs) is served only as ZIP (783 KB for 2026); asking for .json answers 400 (filename format error); probe cannot verify ZIP

NII IRDB OAI-PMH needs a full datetime from= (badArgument on a date) and the unbounded harvest is millions of records; an incremental window needs a rolling date the engine cannot express, and per-institution sets duplicate the repo.nii.ac.jp OAI rows already registered
JaLC doilist is per prefix (an entity pivot, 643 DOIs for this one); the prefix registry itself is the row written
323,358 BioSamples with geoLocName=Japan; page paging stops at page*perPage=10,000 and the cursor mode refuses search filters, so the filtered set cannot be walked to the end
Vehicle recall and defect statistics are PDFs only; the yearly recall lists are HTML press-release index pages (recall.html already registered)
2026 preliminary food-poisoning list (564 cases) is re-uploaded under a new content number on every update; the final 2025 list was written instead
Fetched OK (47 prefectures x 12 years = 564 rows) - thin next to SSDSE-A; SSDSE-C (49 rows) and SSDSE-E (47 rows) likewise
GSI municipal area table: ~2,400 lines of which the first several are prose notes in column B; low-value aggregate
Heatstroke ambulance data split into one sheet per month (2025_05 = 1,457 rows: 31 days x 47 prefectures); the 2026 file (r8) answers 404
Fetched OK, 170 taxa - thin; the 2025 vascular plant list (2,222) was written instead
Fetched OK, 2,811 rows of jk_id to municipality-id links - thin next to the nrct/edo-village tables written
29 newest notices - a strict subset of area/00A.xml, which was written
NDL law index is a Vue SPA over undocumented /api/v1/search/* endpoints; no published API or file

Recent-judgments list is server-rendered HTML whose anchors carry only the category label (知的財産裁判例), so html mode would title every record identically; a keyword pivot on the old app/hanrei_jp path is already registered
JAMSTEC cruise/dive/sample search is a form-driven map UI; no list or file endpoint found
UR rental internal API is per-property POST (bukken/room by shisya+danchi); no bulk list
JREC-IN job search returns the search form, not a result list; no RSS or API found
Already registered and now answers 404; no feed on tenbou.nies.go.jp
emdb answers 500 (the registered monitoring_post/latest.json answers 302 to it)
Summary A/B tables are prefecture and municipality aggregates of the same certifications whose facility-level lists are written
Fetched (Tokyo 1,305, Hokkaido 9,751, Fukuoka 10,583 facilities); held back - the 8 largest prefectures already fill the 8-rows-per-host cap
Fetched (Osaka 3,295, Tokyo 3,335 sections); held back for host diversity - the five largest prefecture tables are written
Fetched OK (7,028 offices); held back - www.mhlw.go.jp already carries 8 rows in this manifest; services 110-160 of the same dataset are registered under older edition URLs
Fetched OK (1,860 external-use drugs); held back for the same www.mhlw.go.jp host cap
Fetched (33,663 cases) but the first rows mix merged group headers with line-broken cells; held back after three clean years were written
404 - the keyless API lives under /api/emp/; the written rows use that path
